event_name: Williams Martini Racing Document 40 Date 27 May 2018 Time 15:57 2018 MONACO GRAND PRIX 23 - 27 May 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (Document 39), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 35 did not have all wheels fitted at the 3 minute signal.
offence: Breach of Article 36.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: Above penalty is as determined under Article 38.3(d) of the Regulations. Nish Shetty Jose Abed Danny Sullivan Eric Barrabino
rules_referenced: Article 36.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: 2018 Monaco Grand Prix Offence Car 35 Wheels Not All Fitted At 3Mins40
